extName.description: Extension name. Brand, do not translate.

extDescription.message: Explains YouTube expressions whose meaning you can't guess from the words. Try sample videos free; others need a Mistral API key.
extDescription.description: Web Store description. Max 132 characters (checked at build).

panelDisclaimer.message: These explanations are machine-generated; the meaning in the scene may be wrong.
panelDisclaimer.description: Always-on notice above the item list.

panelReviewedNote.description: Replaces the disclaimer on reviewed sample videos.

panelBadgeCached.description: Header badge: result came from local cache.

panelBadgeReviewedTitle.message: This list was checked by hand before release; items found wrong or invented were removed.

panelFollowBack.description: Button shown after the user scrolls the list manually.

panelCopyTitle.message: Copy items to the clipboard as JSON

itemReportTitle.message: Mark this item as wrong (saved only in this browser)
itemReportTitle.description: Tooltip. Reports are NOT sent anywhere.

buttonPrepare.description: Primary button: fetch captions for this video.

buttonReprocessOwnKey.description: Small secondary action on sample videos.

noKeyIntro.message: This video hasn't been processed yet.

noKeyShowcaseLabel.message: Sample videos you can try without a key:

noKeyByok.message: Process any video with your own key

noKeyPaid.description: Shown under the link, on its own line.

noKeyLater.message: A free option is in the works.

statusReady.message: Ready. Press the button to start.

statusBusy.message: Another video is being processed. You can start this one when it finishes.

statusNeedsKey.message: This video needs an API key.

statusNotPrepared.message: This video hasn't been prepared yet.

statusFromCache.message: Loaded from cache — no model call made.

statusFatalPartial.message: The partial result in the list was not saved.
statusFatalPartial.description: Appended after a fatal error message when some items were already shown.

statusNoCaptions.message: No captions found for this video.

failureNotePartial.message: Partial result not saved. Press “Reprocess” for the full result.
failureNotePartial.description: Must name the Reprocess button label.

failureChannel.message: Couldn't reach the extension's background process.
failureChannel.description: A message to the service worker failed.

asrNote.message: Source is auto-generated captions: the text may be misheard, and so may the items.

summaryItems.description: Number-independent on purpose (no plural rules in chrome.i18n).

summaryMoved.description: Items relocated to the correct caption line.

emptyTitle.message: No expressions to mark in this video

emptyDetail.message: We only mark expressions whose meaning can't be guessed from their words; not every video has them.

emptyDetailRejected.message: Items generated by the model: $PRODUCED$; removed by post-generation checks: $REJECTED$ (e.g. invented wording, sentence fragments, proper names).

captionErrNoPlayerResponse.message: Couldn't read YouTube's player data. Reload the page and try again.

captionErrNoCaptionTracks.message: This video has no captions, so there's no text to process.

captionErrSourceNotEnglish.message: This video's source language isn't English. The extension only works with English captions.

captionErrTriggerFailed.message: Couldn't trigger the caption request. Reload the page and try again.

captionErrEmptyBody.message: YouTube returned an empty response. Wait a moment and try again.

captionErrFetchFailed.message: Couldn't download the captions. Check your connection and try again.

captionErrParseFailed.message: Unrecognized caption format. YouTube may have changed it.

captionErrRateLimited.message: YouTube received too many requests and is withholding captions for a while. Wait about a minute.

captionErrStalePlayerResponse.message: The page data belongs to another video. Reload the page and try again.

annotateErrNoApiKey.message: No Mistral API key set. Add your key in the extension settings.

annotateErrApiError.message: Couldn't reach the provider, or the request was rejected.

annotateErrRateLimited.message: Your key hit its rate limit.

annotateErrInvalidResponse.message: The model's response wasn't in the expected format.

annotateErrModelNotInTier.message: This model isn't included in your key's plan.

annotateErrUnknownModel.message: The requested model isn't on the allowed list.

annotateErrUnknownModelAllowed.message: The requested model isn't on the allowed list. Allowed: $MODELS$.
annotateErrUnknownModelAllowed.description: MODELS is a comma-separated list of model ids.

annotateErrPermissionMissing.message: Mistral access permission not granted — save your key again on the settings page.

optionsLeadFree.message: You can try the sample videos without a key.

optionsLeadKey.message: Your own key is only needed for other videos.

optionsKeyPaid.message: A paid account (with a payment method) is required:

optionsKeyPaidWhy.message: a free account's key can't access the models this extension uses.

optionsKeyStorage.message: Your key is stored only in this browser and sent only to Mistral (api.mistral.ai).

optionsKeyDelete.message: To delete it, leave the field empty and save.

optionsStatusDeleted.message: Key deleted; Mistral access permission revoked.

optionsStatusDeletedPermissionKept.message: Key deleted; couldn't revoke Mistral access permission.

optionsStatusPermissionDenied.message: Key not saved: Mistral access permission was not granted. Your key is sent only to api.mistral.ai, which requires this permission.
